title: 工程克隆与删除必须服从资源所有权边界
summary: 项目目录是否由应用完整管理决定了克隆/删除能做什么。自动管理根可整体删除；手工工程根只能删除明确拥有的状态/输出/marker，必须保留未知或用户文件。克隆复制可复用生成输入，但不复制旧输出和运行状态。
rules: Managed project roots may be removed as a whole only when explicitly marked managed.
Manual roots preserve arbitrary/unowned files and remove only known owned state/output/metadata.
Clone destinations must differ from the source and must not overwrite a non-empty destination.
Generated project-local inputs may be copied; manual relative user inputs are rebound to their original absolute resources instead of silently duplicated.
Outputs and runtime state are not inherited by a semantic project clone unless explicitly requested.
Destructive project deletion should be blocked while owned jobs are active and may require verified recovery evidence.
